## WF15 – After-sales router
Change / cancellation / refund requests become **human tasks** – the system never states penalties or refund amounts.
Finds the booking (PNR or the agent's ticketed booking for the mentioned date) → CHANGE_REQUESTED / REFUND_REQUESTED → priority (travel < 24 h → CRITICAL) → Ticketing / Refund desk → neutral acknowledgement.
